contact.evidence_quote: In 2022, the MIC LGBTQI+ Staff Network was formed with the aim of the group being an informal social and peer-to-peer support LGBTQI+ network. The group aims to be a community for LGBTQI+ staff members, to engage their allies at MIC and a support for those considering their own identity. ... Contact Edel.Foster@mic.ul.ie <edel.foster@mic.ul.ie> for more information.
